title: 第2章 给人当老爷爷
slug: 史上第一祖师爷全本免费-史上第一祖师爷最新章节列表
content_zh:
林锋淡然说道：“本座前日心血来潮，突然感到一个与我有缘之人在这山中，于是便来寻访，却没想到，竟在这样一个小山村中遇见。”
说着，林锋的视线转向村口拖着狗尾巴仍一脸茫然的小不点，心中暗叹：“人家当主角，会随身带老爷爷，而我却要去给别人当老爷爷。”
不过，想到一群逆天主角给自己当徒弟，日后有事了就让这群逆天的徒弟们去大杀四方，林锋心情顿时好了许多。
“眼前这就是第一个。”
老村长愣了一下，也看向小不点：“道长说的，是……他？”
林锋淡淡的点头：“本座原先还奇怪哪来的有缘人，现在见了此子，才明白事情原委。”
他慨然一叹，将准备好的一个故事娓娓道来。
在这个故事中，林锋曾经有一个得意弟子，却因为看不破情关心魔，以至于渡劫失败，兵解转世。
林锋一直寻找转世之后的弟子，希望可以再续师徒之缘，结果悠悠百年，终于在今日找到。
老村长被他侃得一愣一愣的，难以置信的看向小不点：“小不点，就是您的弟子转世？”
林锋微微点头，看向小不点的目光里流露出一分不易察觉却恰到好处的舔犊关爱之情。
做戏做全套，林锋是尽自己最大努力了，但心中却不乐观。
因为他注意到，老村长错愕的神情下，分明隐藏着一股浓浓的警惕之意。
老头子甚至一只手背到身后，冲着小不点轻微摇动。
林锋暗暗蹙眉，他在老头子身上感受到了一股熟悉的气息波动。
修真者的法力波动。
这个小山村中的老人，竟然是一个修真者，虽然只有练气三层，但却是货真价实的修真者。
修真者和武者不同，想要成为修真者，引导天地灵气入体练成法力，必须要修练道法。
狼村的狼风，也算有修练天赋了，但仍然只是武者，算不得修真者。
之前老村长特意隐藏自身气息，林锋还没有注意到，现在因为对林锋起了戒备之意，体内自然而然起了法力波动，立刻便被林锋察觉。

林锋暗叹一声，虽然老头子未必是他对手，但他是想给小不点当师父，当传说中的老爷爷，而不是当人贩子拐卖，强行抢人显然是不行的。
林锋看着小不点，淡然问道：“清风，你如今可愿重归为师门下？”
老村长脸上神情不变，背在身后的手都快摇断了。
小不点迷糊的挠挠头，看看林锋，再看看老村长，有些忸怩的说道：“咿呀，我……我不叫清风，我也不想离开村子。”
林锋沉默不语，气氛一时间变得僵硬，老村长紧张的注视着他，一身法力波动越来越明显，随时准备动手。
“罢了，你宿智未开，不记得前生之事，为师也不强求。”就在老村长已经快要崩溃的时候，林锋轻叹一声，终于开口：“不过为师算到你我缘分未尽，今日一别，终有再见之日。”
林锋从怀中取出一枚紫色护符递给小不点：“这枚护符，为师留给你防身，若遇到危险，便将护符扔向敌人，当可护你周全，你我有缘再见。”
说罢，再不拖拉，林锋转身就走，临路过老村长身边，林锋轻描淡写扫了他一眼，嘴角边露出似笑非笑的神情，却不说话，直接离开。
老村长吓出一身冷汗，知道林锋已经看破他的底细，可他却看不出林锋修为深浅，这让他阵阵后怕，直觉林锋修为高出他太多，怕不是筑基期甚至金丹期的大修士？
修真者平时可以将气息内敛，但稍有波动就会被同层次或者更高层次的修真者发觉，不过林锋是个例外。
这或许是系统的一项隐性福利了，按照系统说明，只要林锋自己不出手，在别人看来他和普通人没有任何区别，就算修为比他高的修真者也看不穿。
这非常有利于林锋装逼。
离开了小不点和老村长的视线，林锋立刻使用潜行术，又偷偷溜回石村。
兑换系统中最便宜的小法术都要一百兑换点数，林锋仔细考虑之后没有选择攻击或者防御的法术，而是兑换了潜行术。
可以隐藏自己的身形，只要不做其他事情便不会显形，在林锋看来，这门法术使用得法的话，实用性很强。
老村长的反应有些怪，让林锋起了疑心。

content_en:
Lin Feng said calmly: "On a whim the day before yesterday, I suddenly felt that a person who was destined for me was in this mountain, so I came to look for him, but I didn't expect that I would meet him in such a small mountain village."
As he said that, Lin Feng turned his eyes to the little boy dragging his dog's tail at the entrance of the village, still looking confused, and sighed in his heart: "When someone is the protagonist, they will take their grandfather with them, but I have to be someone else's grandfather."
However, Lin Feng suddenly felt much better when he thought of a group of unfaithful protagonists who would serve as his apprentices. If something happened in the future, he would let these unfaithful disciples kill everyone.
"This is the first one right now."
The old village chief was stunned for a moment, and then looked at the little one: "The Taoist priest is talking about...him?"
Lin Feng nodded lightly: "I was originally wondering where this destined person came from, but now that I have met this person, I understand the whole story."
He sighed with emotion and told a story he had prepared.
In this story, Lin Feng once had a proud disciple, but because he could not see through the demons of love and concern, he failed to escape the tribulation and was reincarnated.
Lin Feng has been looking for his reincarnated disciple, hoping to renew the relationship between master and disciple, but after hundreds of years, he finally found him today.
The old village chief was stunned by his talk and looked at the little one in disbelief: "Little one, is this the reincarnation of your disciple?"
Lin Feng nodded slightly, looking at the little boy with a hint of care and concern that was subtle but just right.
Lin Feng tried his best to perform the full set, but he was not optimistic in his heart.
Because he noticed that there was clearly a strong sense of vigilance hidden under the old village chief's astonished expression.
The old man even put one hand behind his back and shook it slightly at the little one.
Lin Feng frowned secretly. He felt a familiar aura wave on the old man's body.
The cultivator's mana fluctuates.
The old man in this small mountain village turned out to be a cultivator. Although he only had the third level of Qi training, he was a genuine cultivator.
Cultivators are different from warriors. If you want to become a cultivator and guide the spiritual energy of heaven and earth into your body to develop magic power, you must practice Taoism.
Lang Feng from Lang Village can be considered talented in cultivation, but he is still only a warrior, not a cultivator.
Before, the old village chief deliberately concealed his aura, but Lin Feng had not noticed it yet. Now because he was wary of Lin Feng, mana fluctuations naturally occurred in his body, and Lin Feng immediately noticed it.
Lin Feng secretly sighed. Although the old man may not be his opponent, he wanted to be a master and a legendary grandfather for the little one, not a human trafficker. It was obviously not possible to rob someone by force.
Lin Feng looked at the little one and asked calmly: "Qingfeng, are you willing to return to your master's sect now?"
The expression on the old village chief's face remained unchanged, and the hand behind his back was almost broken.
The little boy scratched his head in confusion, looked at Lin Feng, then at the old village chief, and said a little shyly: "Hey, I... my name is not Qingfeng, and I don't want to leave the village."
Lin Feng remained silent, and the atmosphere became stiff for a moment. The old village chief stared at him nervously, his mana fluctuations becoming more and more obvious, and he was ready to take action at any time.
"That's all, you haven't awakened your wisdom. You don't remember the events of your previous life, and you don't force me to be my teacher." Just when the old village chief was about to collapse, Lin Feng sighed softly and finally said, "But as my teacher, we have not finished our fate. We say goodbye today, and we will see each other again one day."
Lin Feng took out a purple amulet from his arms and handed it to the little one: "This amulet is left for you to defend yourself. If you encounter danger, throw the amulet at the enemy. It will protect you. We are destined to meet again."
After saying that, without further delay, Lin Feng turned around and left. As he passed by the old village chief, Lin Feng glanced at him lightly, with a half-smile on his lips, but left without saying a word.
The old village chief broke out in a cold sweat, knowing that Lin Feng had seen through his true identity, but he could not tell the depth of Lin Feng's cultivation, which made him scared.Intuitively, Lin Feng's cultivation level is much higher than his. Is he probably not a great monk in the foundation building stage or even the golden elixir stage?
Cultivators can usually keep their breath contained, but any slight fluctuation will be noticed by cultivators of the same level or higher, but Lin Feng is an exception.
This may be a hidden benefit of the system. According to the system description, as long as Lin Feng does not take action himself, in the eyes of others, there is no difference between him and ordinary people. Even cultivators with higher cultivation levels than him cannot see through it.
This is very helpful for Lin Feng to show off.
Out of the sight of the little boy and the old village chief, Lin Feng immediately used the stealth technique and sneaked back to Stone Village.
The cheapest small spell in the exchange system cost one hundred exchange points. After careful consideration, Lin Feng did not choose an attack or defense spell, but exchanged it for the stealth spell.
It can hide one's body shape and will not appear as long as one does not do other things. In Lin Feng's opinion, this spell is very practical if used correctly.
The old village chief's reaction was a bit strange, which made Lin Feng suspicious.
